final:
title_of(html: str) -> str =
  ex title_of("<html><head><title>Hello World</title></head></html>") == "Hello World"
  ex title_of("no title here") == ""
  let parts = html.split("<title>")
  let after = parts.get(1) else return ""
  let inside = after.split("</title>")
  let rest = inside.get(1) else return ""
  copy inside[0]
